name: lucid
description: Restrained, readable transcript for dark and light terminals: warm greys, AA contrast, an orange bar on questions to you, sand titles, quiet tool rows that mark their kind, count their changes, say why they failed and show live output. A race start in front of the spinner and a chequered flag at the end of each turn. A mouse selection pastes rendered prose and code lines exactly as written; for the markdown source use copy-that.
